metadata.description: A sharp little toolkit of agent plugins — guided workflow, work folders + checkpoints, deep research, persistent memory.

plugins.name: guide
plugins.description: Toolkit map and composition guide (using-katana), injected at session start

plugins.name: work-folder
plugins.description: Work-folder convention (injected at session start) + checkpoint skill for cross-session save/resume

plugins.name: deep-research
plugins.description: Deep research landing artifacts in a dedicated work folder (work-folder MCP) — multi-round Workflow orchestration over wiki/work-folder MCP, the web, and named sources; judgment-driven stop, cited report

plugins.name: memory
plugins.description: Operational memory system for Claude Code — auto-injects verified facts as L1 index at session start, with skills for card lifecycle management

plugins.name: obsidian-md
plugins.description: Obsidian Markdown writing rules grounded in official docs — wikilinks, headings, frontmatter, embeds, callouts; never invent syntax

plugins.name: wiki
plugins.description: LLM-maintained wiki engine — schema-driven zones, provenance-enforced ingest, deterministic query ladder, adversarial lint

plugins.name: retrieval
plugins.description: Multi-source information retrieval — intent→source routing, credibility ladder, fallback chains; web/reddit/twitter/code/github/gitlab/linear/feishu/search-note adapters with externalized auth

plugins.name: fpa
plugins.description: First Principles Analysis — decompose the goal into effect-level needs before touching the incumbent, put every claimed hard constraint on trial, and rebuild only from the constraints that survive

plugins.name: feishu-docs
plugins.description: Mirror Feishu DocX as local block-tree AST (SSoT) + read-only Markdown; one-way pull (P0)

plugins.name: incubate
plugins.description: Idea incubator — accrete ideas/commentary/inspiration around one concrete topic into output-ready material for a later propose/design doc; reuses work-folder control files, five modes

plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: Document writing + readability review engine — write gate (read project patterns/opinions, fixed self-check), readability-check (machine + cold-read subagent, feedback evolution), bluf structure SSoT; project-specific templates/opinions externalized via .katana writing_dir

plugins.name: jury
plugins.description: Multi-model review jury — parallel diverse-model review with divergence-preserving vote

plugins.name: line-supervisor
plugins.description: Single-line supervisor — hourly checklist + event monitor for one fleet-graph goal line; three-rung repair ladder (change facts / fix supervisor tooling / file defects for the line), gates stay self-judged by the line
